# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability in any of my public repositories, please **do not open a public issue**. Instead, report it privately:

- Use GitHub's [private vulnerability reporting](https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/security-advisories/guidance-on-reporting-and-writing/privately-reporting-a-security-vulnerability) on the affected repository, if enabled, **or**
- Contact [@Hajime-No-Ippo](https://github.com/Hajime-No-Ippo) directly via GitHub.

Please include:

- A description of the vulnerability and its potential impact
- Steps to reproduce, or a proof of concept
- Any relevant logs, versions, or configuration

## Response

I'll do my best to acknowledge reports promptly and follow up with a fix or mitigation timeline. Please allow reasonable time to address the issue before any public disclosure.
